rulebook.title: League
items: 15 roster spots plus 3 IR spots. IR is for players listed OUT only.
Waivers process on Sundays, so claims count for the next week's lineup.

rulebook.title: Keepers
items: Each team keeps 8 players every season.
Keepers are free: no salary, no contract and no limit on how many years you keep a player.

rulebook.title: Draft
items: The 2026 startup draft was an auction.
Every draft after that is 7 rounds for rookies and non-kept players, fully linear.
Draft order is worst regular-season record first for picks 1–7. The champion always picks last.

rulebook.title: Playoffs and payouts
items: Payouts are based on playoff results only. No money for regular-season standings.

rulebook.title: Dues
items: Seasons 1 and 2 were paid upfront. After that, dues are always paid one season ahead.
Leave the league early and your prepaid dues go to whoever takes over your team.

rulebook.title: Trades
items: Players are traded through Yahoo as normal.
Picks can be traded for any future draft, as long as the team has paid dues for every season up to and including that pick's year.
Every trade is logged on this site, which is the official record for picks.
